governing_rule: Route each polynomial application through a narrow obligation, explicit excluded inference, bounded method, controlled execution ledger, and replayable certificate.

lanes.name: Diophantine systems
lanes.local_obligation: derive eliminants and algebraic branches before exact arithmetic reconstruction
lanes.excluded_inference: solutions over an algebraic closure do not by themselves prove integer or rational solvability
lanes.first_fixture: Solve x + y = 5 and xy = 6 algebraically, reconstruct both branches, and certify integrality.
lanes.switch_condition: Switch to number-theoretic methods when arithmetic obstructions dominate the algebraic relaxation.

lanes.name: Automated geometry
lanes.source_object: coordinate geometry theorem with explicit nondegeneracy hypotheses
lanes.local_obligation: compile the theorem conclusion into ideal or radical membership
lanes.excluded_inference: a polynomial identity does not certify that the coordinates cover exactly the intended geometric configurations
lanes.first_fixture: Certify a small coordinate theorem with one nondegeneracy condition and a human-readable semantic bridge.
lanes.switch_condition: Switch encoding or use synthetic proof when coordinates obscure the theorem or inflate the witness.

lanes.name: Signal and image systems
lanes.source_object: small exact convolution, calibration, or reconstruction model
lanes.local_obligation: establish algebraic identifiability and enumerate exact branches
lanes.excluded_inference: algebraic identifiability does not establish numerical stability, robustness to noise, or perceptual quality
lanes.first_fixture: Recover a two-tap exact signal from a noiseless polynomial convolution model and expose non-identifiable branches.
lanes.switch_condition: Switch to interval or numerical analysis when perturbation and conditioning are the actual obligations.

lanes.name: Robotics
lanes.local_obligation: eliminate auxiliary variables and isolate feasible real configurations
lanes.excluded_inference: complex algebraic solutions do not establish real reachability, collision freedom, or joint-limit feasibility
lanes.first_fixture: Solve a two-link planar inverse-kinematics target with exact real-root isolation and joint-limit filtering.
lanes.switch_condition: Switch to numerical continuation or interval methods when exact elimination exceeds its budget.

lanes.name: Sudoku and finite constraints
lanes.source_object: small finite-domain puzzle or Latin constraint system
lanes.local_obligation: certify existence, inconsistency, or uniqueness of a bounded instance
lanes.excluded_inference: a polynomial encoding is not automatically the best solver and must be compared with SAT or combinatorial search
lanes.first_fixture: Encode a 4 by 4 Sudoku instance, recover its solution, and certify uniqueness with an independent finite checker.
lanes.switch_condition: Switch to SAT when the polynomial certificate is larger or less transparent than the proof-producing Boolean route.

lanes.name: Reconstruction and missing data
lanes.source_object: partial measurements under an explicit polynomial generative model
lanes.local_obligation: determine completion branches and whether the missing values are identifiable
lanes.excluded_inference: algebraic completion does not establish scientific, causal, historical, or palaeontological truth
lanes.first_fixture: Complete one missing coordinate in a small exact model and certify whether the completion is unique or branched.
lanes.switch_condition: Reject the lane when the scientific model cannot justify the polynomial constraints.
